    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LocalFacility" name="Local Service Facility" processRef="Process_LocalFacility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SymptomsToCenter" name="Symptoms and fridge type" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestToFacility" name="Service request" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AppointmentToCustomer" name="Appointment" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="Catch_AppointmentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairToCustomer" name="Fridge repaired" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" targetRef="Catch_RepairCompletedReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Fridge makes strange noises"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSymptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_SymptomsAndType"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_AppointmentReceived" name="Appointment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AppointmentReceived" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairCompletedReceived" name="Repair completed received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairCompletedReceived" messageRef="Msg_RepairCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmRepair" name="Confirm fridge is working again"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateSplit" name="Rate service facility?" default="Flow_SkipRating"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateFacility" name="Rate service facility"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateJoin" name="Rating finished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Customer" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="ManualTask_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="ManualTask_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="Catch_AppointmentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Catch_AppointmentReceived" targetRef="Catch_RepairCompletedReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Catch_RepairCompletedReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmRepair" targetRef="Gateway_RateSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateFacility" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Task_RateFacility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsToRate}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipRating" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Gateway_RateJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="Gateway_RateJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Gateway_RateJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CentralCenter" name="Central Fridge Service Center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Center" name="Request received"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveSymptoms" name="Receive symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_SymptomsAndType"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility">
      <bpmn:documentation>Each local service facility has its own way of interacting with customers.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ForwardRequest" name="Forward service request to facility" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Center" name="Facility selected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_K1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Center" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_K2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveSymptoms" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_K3" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_K4" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_Center"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LocalFacility" name="Local Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Facility" name="Request received"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive service request" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment to customer" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ArrivalAtCustomer" name="Arrival at customer at random time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AttemptRepair" name="Attempt repair"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsSplit" name="Additional parts needed?" default="Flow_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing fridge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainParts" name="Obtain additional parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair fridge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" name="Send repair completed notice" messageRef="Msg_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Facility" name="Repair completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Facility" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="SendTask_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="Catch_ArrivalAtCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Catch_ArrivalAtCustomer" targetRef="Task_AttemptRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="Task_AttemptRepair" targetRef="Gateway_PartsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveWithoutRepair" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsSplit" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalPartsNeeded}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFridge" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F10" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Task_ObtainParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F11" sourceRef="Task_ObtainParts" targetRef="Catch_ArrivalAtCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F12" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F13" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" targetRef="EndEvent_Facility"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
